resumen:
The marketing concept: success depends on identifying and satisfying consumer needs and wants (slide 2-3).
Needs vs wants and the exchange process (two parties, communication, freedom to accept or decline) (slide 4-5).
The marketing mix (product, price, place, promotion) and target markets that must be sizeable, reachable, measurable and behavioral (slide 7-11).
Niche marketing, market segmentation and its five bases (slide 14-40).
Positioning, positioning maps, product differentiation, re-positioning and types of advertising (slide 41-74).
